milestone.describes: PLAY! enters a live round: the island map with its runways and helipads, the AIRCRAFT LANDED and HI SCORE readouts, an aircraft in flight, and the pause and fast-forward controls.

steps.expect: The main menu: High Score, the stats tabs, map select, PLAY! and Multiplayer.
A live round. The map draws with runways and helipads and at least one aircraft is in the air.
Still playing, and the aircraft have moved — two captures this far apart must differ.

notes: Portrait and native: no launch options, and the window is the iPad's 768x1024 the right way up.
PLAY! is at the bottom of the menu. A tap at the middle of the screen hits nothing, which reads exactly like broken input — that false alarm is recorded in the app note.

This route did not run at all between the initial-reachability work and 2026-08-15: the app died about five seconds into startup. If a replay stops at 'boot' again, check whether a callback is being handed a pointer into a caller's stack frame before looking at the app.
